name: Burelle SA
summary: Burelle SA, through its subsidiaries, provides automotive equipment in France and internationally. The company offers outdoor and lighting systems, complex modules, and energy storage systems, as well as battery and hydrogen electrification solutions. It also owns office buildings and hotels; and various real estate properties located in the Hauts-de-Seine and Lyon regions. Further, the company invests in private equity funds. Burelle SA was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Lyon, France.
